senses.gloss: f. (pl. as a collect. noun) (denom. of אִיקוֹן) a procession in which portable images are carried.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite> <he>א׳ של מלאכים וכ׳</he> a procession of angels passes before man and they cry, Make room <he>לאיקוניה של וכ׳</he> (read <he>לְאִקוֹנָיו</he> or <he>לְאִיקוֹנוֹת</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 670:6">Yalk. Ps. 670</cite>; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 4:4">Deut. R. s. 4</cite> <cite ref="L00521"><he>לאִיקוֹנִין</he></cite>) for the images of the Lord (man being created in the image of God). Deut. R. l. c. <he>או׳ מהלכת</he> (corr. acc.).
